title: AI Agents Break Free from Solo Dev Mode
excerpt: AI coding assistants are moving beyond individual developer use cases into collaborative team environments. This shift has significant implications for software testing, security practices, and enterprise development workflows.
post_draft:
What happens when AI coding assistants stop working alone?

We're about to find out. AI agents are moving out of solo dev mode and into team environments—and this changes everything about how we test and secure our code.

In our latest piece, we explore what this shift really means for your development workflow. You'll discover how collaborative AI is reshaping code review practices, where new security blind spots are emerging, and why your testing strategy needs to evolve right now.

The tools are changing faster than most teams can adapt. Understanding this transition isn't optional anymore—it's essential for staying ahead of the risks and opportunities.

Read the full analysis to see how AI orchestration is redefining what secure, collaborative development looks like.
